policy: A stored artifact may pass its build check on a successor only when a recorded link joins the two, the link names an ADOPTED decision, and the link's proof is exactly the block-canary digests recorded on the predecessor build. The canary check re-runs those cells on the successor, so a link cannot bless a build that serves different rows.

links.note: MAX_PREDICTIONS is named as the returned window and split into transition and cooccurrence allocations; every served row is unchanged, proven by the four recorded canary digests.

retired_note: The 0.14.0 cap-40 build is superseded, not carried: the cap is inside the cell, so the canary digests moved and no equivalence link can join the two builds. The link is kept here as the record of E1.
